🎥🎬: 9-1-1 (2018)

Working on the front lines of emergency response, the brave men and women of Los Angeles’s 9-1-1 call centre, police department, fire department and paramedic teams face some of the most terrifying and unpredictable situations imaginable. Every emergency call brings a new crisis, and every second can mean the difference between life and death.

Led by experienced first responders like Athena Grant, Bobby Nash, Evan “Buck” Buckley and Hen Wilson, the team tackles everything from devastating accidents and dangerous rescues to bizarre emergencies and life-threatening disasters. But while they spend their days saving strangers, their personal lives are filled with struggles, heartbreak, relationships and difficult decisions.

As the emergencies become more intense, the team discovers that being a first responder means carrying the weight of other people’s lives while trying to keep their own lives together.
